quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Maria said, "I walk to school every day."
options: Maria said that she walks to school every day.
Maria said that I walked to school every day.
Maria said that she walked to school every day.
quests.correctAnswer: Maria said that she walked to school every day.
quests.sentence: Maria said, "I walk to school every day."
quests.hint: Check what happens to the verb tense and to the pronoun 'I' when Maria's own words are reported.
quests.explanation: 'Walk' backshifts to 'walked', and 'I' becomes 'she' because Maria is the speaker being reported.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Daniel said, "I play the guitar on weekends."
options: Daniel said that he plays the guitar on weekends.
Daniel said that I played the guitar on weekends.
Daniel said that he played the guitar on weekends.
quests.correctAnswer: Daniel said that he played the guitar on weekends.
quests.sentence: Daniel said, "I play the guitar on weekends."
quests.hint: Look for two changes: the verb moves one step into the past, and 'I' becomes a pronoun referring to Daniel.
quests.explanation: 'Play' shifts back to 'played', and 'I' changes to 'he' since we are reporting Daniel's statement.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Grace said, "I live near the station."
options: Grace said that she lives near the station.
Grace said that she lived near the station.
Grace said that her lived near the station.
quests.correctAnswer: Grace said that she lived near the station.
quests.sentence: Grace said, "I live near the station."
quests.hint: Decide whether you need a subject pronoun ('she') or a possessive ('her'), and remember present simple moves one step back.
quests.explanation: 'Live' shifts to 'lived', and the subject pronoun 'I' becomes the subject pronoun 'she', not the possessive 'her'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Omar said, "I am waiting for the bus."
options: Omar said that he is waiting for the bus.
Omar said that I was waiting for the bus.
Omar said that he was waiting for the bus.
quests.correctAnswer: Omar said that he was waiting for the bus.
quests.sentence: Omar said, "I am waiting for the bus."
quests.hint: 'Am' is part of the present continuous — think about what it becomes in the past, and who 'I' refers to.
quests.explanation: 'Am waiting' (present continuous) shifts to 'was waiting' (past continuous); 'I' becomes 'he' since Omar is being reported.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Fatima said, "I am cooking dinner."
options: Fatima said that she is cooking dinner.
Fatima said that she was cooked dinner.
Fatima said that she was cooking dinner.
quests.correctAnswer: Fatima said that she was cooking dinner.
quests.sentence: Fatima said, "I am cooking dinner."
quests.hint: The auxiliary 'am' must shift, but keep the '-ing' form of the verb.
quests.explanation: 'Am cooking' becomes 'was cooking' — the auxiliary changes but the '-ing' form stays; 'I' becomes 'she'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Kwame said, "I am reading a good book."
options: Kwame said that he was reading a good book.
Kwame said that I was reading a good book.
Kwame said that he is reading a good book.
quests.correctAnswer: Kwame said that he was reading a good book.
quests.sentence: Kwame said, "I am reading a good book."
quests.hint: Two changes are needed: the continuous auxiliary and the pronoun referring to Kwame.
quests.explanation: 'Am reading' shifts to 'was reading', and 'I' becomes 'he' because Kwame is the one being quoted.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Elena said, "My brother works at the hospital."
options: Elena said that my brother worked at the hospital.
Elena said that her brother works at the hospital.
Elena said that her brother worked at the hospital.
quests.correctAnswer: Elena said that her brother worked at the hospital.
quests.sentence: Elena said, "My brother works at the hospital."
quests.hint: 'My' belongs to Elena, so think about which possessive pronoun refers to her; also check the verb tense.
quests.explanation: 'My' becomes 'her' because Elena is the speaker, and 'works' backshifts to 'worked'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Marcus said, "My car needs a repair."
options: Marcus said that his car needs a repair.
Marcus said that his car needed a repair.
Marcus said that my car needed a repair.
quests.correctAnswer: Marcus said that his car needed a repair.
quests.sentence: Marcus said, "My car needs a repair."
quests.hint: Identify who 'my' refers to before choosing the possessive pronoun.
quests.explanation: 'My' shifts to 'his' since Marcus owns the car, and 'needs' shifts to 'needed'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Nadia said, "My parents live in Portugal."
options: Nadia said that her parents live in Portugal.
Nadia said that their parents lived in Portugal.
Nadia said that her parents lived in Portugal.
quests.correctAnswer: Nadia said that her parents lived in Portugal.
quests.sentence: Nadia said, "My parents live in Portugal."
quests.hint: The possessive pronoun depends on who is speaking, not on whether the noun after it is plural.
quests.explanation: 'My' refers to Nadia, so it becomes 'her' regardless of 'parents' being plural; 'live' backshifts to 'lived'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Victor said, "I am tired after work."
options: Victor said that he were tired after work.
Victor said that he was tired after work.
Victor said that he is tired after work.
quests.correctAnswer: Victor said that he was tired after work.
quests.sentence: Victor said, "I am tired after work."
quests.hint: Match the pronoun to the correct past form of 'to be': was or were?
quests.explanation: 'Am' becomes 'was' with the singular pronoun 'he', and 'I' changes to 'he'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Isabella said, "The lake is very cold."
options: Isabella said that the lake was very cold.
Isabella said that the lake is very cold.
Isabella said that the lake were very cold.
quests.correctAnswer: Isabella said that the lake was very cold.
quests.sentence: Isabella said, "The lake is very cold."
quests.hint: This subject is not 'I' — focus only on the correct past form of 'to be'.
quests.explanation: 'Is' shifts to 'was' because the subject 'the lake' is singular; no pronoun change is needed here.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Hassan said, "I am ready for the interview."
options: Hassan said that he is ready for the interview.
Hassan said that he was ready for the interview.
Hassan said that I was ready for the interview.
quests.correctAnswer: Hassan said that he was ready for the interview.
quests.sentence: Hassan said, "I am ready for the interview."
quests.hint: Apply both changes you have practiced: the verb 'to be' and the pronoun 'I'.
quests.explanation: 'Am' becomes 'was', and 'I' becomes 'he' since Hassan is being reported.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Sofia said, "I don't like spicy food."
options: Sofia said that she not liked spicy food.
Sofia said that she doesn't like spicy food.
Sofia said that she didn't like spicy food.
quests.correctAnswer: Sofia said that she didn't like spicy food.
quests.sentence: Sofia said, "I don't like spicy food."
quests.hint: Negative present simple uses 'don't' or 'doesn't' — what does this become in the past?
quests.explanation: 'Don't like' shifts to 'didn't like', and 'I' becomes 'she'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Ravi said, "My sister doesn't drive."
options: Ravi said that his sister doesn't drive.
Ravi said that my sister didn't drive.
Ravi said that his sister didn't drive.
quests.correctAnswer: Ravi said that his sister didn't drive.
quests.sentence: Ravi said, "My sister doesn't drive."
quests.hint: Two things change here: the possessive pronoun and the negative auxiliary.
quests.explanation: 'My' becomes 'his', and 'doesn't drive' becomes 'didn't drive'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Clara said, "I don't understand the exercise."
options: Clara said that she doesn't understand the exercise.
Clara said that she didn't understand the exercise.
Clara said that I didn't understand the exercise.
quests.correctAnswer: Clara said that she didn't understand the exercise.
quests.sentence: Clara said, "I don't understand the exercise."
quests.hint: Combine the pronoun change with the negative backshift you just practiced.
quests.explanation: 'Don't understand' becomes 'didn't understand', and 'I' becomes 'she'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: The twins said, "We enjoy hiking."
options: The twins said that they enjoyed hiking.
The twins said that we enjoyed hiking.
The twins said that they enjoy hiking.
quests.correctAnswer: The twins said that they enjoyed hiking.
quests.sentence: The twins said, "We enjoy hiking."
quests.hint: 'We' refers to the twins themselves — what pronoun replaces it when their words are reported by someone else?
quests.explanation: 'We' becomes 'they' because the twins are being referred to from outside, and 'enjoy' backshifts to 'enjoyed'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: My neighbors said, "We are moving to a new apartment."
options: My neighbors said that they are moving to a new apartment.
My neighbors said that we were moving to a new apartment.
My neighbors said that they were moving to a new apartment.
quests.correctAnswer: My neighbors said that they were moving to a new apartment.
quests.sentence: My neighbors said, "We are moving to a new apartment."
quests.hint: Apply the same 'we' → 'they' rule together with the present continuous backshift.
quests.explanation: 'We' becomes 'they', and 'are moving' backshifts to 'were moving'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: The coaches said, "We train every morning."
options: The coaches said that we trained every morning.
The coaches said that they trained every morning.
The coaches said that they train every morning.
quests.correctAnswer: The coaches said that they trained every morning.
quests.sentence: The coaches said, "We train every morning."
quests.hint: Third-person reporting always replaces 'we' with the same pronoun — which one?
quests.explanation: 'We' becomes 'they', and 'train' backshifts to 'trained'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: The students said, "Our teacher is very patient."
options: The students said that our teacher was very patient.
The students said that their teacher is very patient.
The students said that their teacher was very patient.
quests.correctAnswer: The students said that their teacher was very patient.
quests.sentence: The students said, "Our teacher is very patient."
quests.hint: 'Our' belongs to the students — decide which possessive pronoun replaces it.
quests.explanation: 'Our' becomes 'their', and 'is' backshifts to 'was'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: The players said, "Our team plays well together."
options: The players said that their team plays well together.
The players said that their team played well together.
The players said that our team played well together.
quests.correctAnswer: The players said that their team played well together.
quests.sentence: The players said, "Our team plays well together."
quests.hint: Keep both rules in mind: the possessive pronoun and the tense of 'play'.
quests.explanation: 'Our' becomes 'their', and 'plays' backshifts to 'played'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: The workers said, "Our manager is very fair."
options: The workers said that their manager is very fair.
The workers said that our manager was very fair.
The workers said that their manager was very fair.
quests.correctAnswer: The workers said that their manager was very fair.
quests.sentence: The workers said, "Our manager is very fair."
quests.hint: Same pattern again — check the possessive pronoun and the verb 'to be'.
quests.explanation: 'Our' becomes 'their', and 'is' backshifts to 'was'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Yuki said, "I lose my keys all the time."
options: Yuki said that I lost her keys all the time.
Yuki said that she loses her keys all the time.
Yuki said that she lost her keys all the time.
quests.correctAnswer: Yuki said that she lost her keys all the time.
quests.sentence: Yuki said, "I lose my keys all the time."
quests.hint: Both the pronoun and the possessive belong to Yuki — check each one separately.
quests.explanation: 'I' becomes 'she' and 'my' becomes 'her'; 'lose' backshifts to 'lost'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Liam said, "I forget my umbrella every winter."
options: Liam said that I forgot my umbrella every winter.
Liam said that he forgot his umbrella every winter.
Liam said that he forgets his umbrella every winter.
quests.correctAnswer: Liam said that he forgot his umbrella every winter.
quests.sentence: Liam said, "I forget my umbrella every winter."
quests.hint: Two separate words need to change to match Liam: the subject pronoun and the possessive.
quests.explanation: 'I' becomes 'he', 'my' becomes 'his', and 'forget' backshifts to 'forgot'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Aisha said, "I love my job."
options: Aisha said that I loved my job.
Aisha said that she loves her job.
Aisha said that she loved her job.
quests.correctAnswer: Aisha said that she loved her job.
quests.sentence: Aisha said, "I love my job."
quests.hint: Change the pronoun, the possessive, and the tense — three small steps in one sentence.
quests.explanation: 'I' becomes 'she', 'my' becomes 'her', and 'love' backshifts to 'loved'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: The manager said, "The project is behind schedule."
options: The manager said that the project has been behind schedule.
The manager said that the project was behind schedule.
The manager said that the project is behind schedule.
quests.correctAnswer: The manager said that the project was behind schedule.
quests.sentence: The manager said, "The project is behind schedule."
quests.hint: Not every reported sentence needs a pronoun change — check only what actually needs to move.
quests.explanation: Only the verb 'to be' backshifts from 'is' to 'was'; there is no pronoun to change here.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Diego said, "I am learning to swim."
options: Diego said that he is learning to swim.
Diego said that he was learn to swim.
Diego said that he was learning to swim.
quests.correctAnswer: Diego said that he was learning to swim.
quests.sentence: Diego said, "I am learning to swim."
quests.hint: Keep the continuous form intact — only the auxiliary and the pronoun move.
quests.explanation: 'Am learning' becomes 'was learning', and 'I' becomes 'he'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Amara said, "My flight leaves early."
options: Amara said that my flight left early.
Amara said that her flight leaves early.
Amara said that her flight left early.
quests.correctAnswer: Amara said that her flight left early.
quests.sentence: Amara said, "My flight leaves early."
quests.hint: Whose flight is it? Choose the possessive that matches the speaker, and backshift the verb.
quests.explanation: 'My' becomes 'her' and 'leaves' backshifts to 'left'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Felix said, "I am the new manager."
options: Felix said that I was the new manager.
Felix said that he was the new manager.
Felix said that he is the new manager.

quests.sentence: Felix said, "I am the new manager."
quests.hint: This combines two of the very first rules you learned — find both of them.
quests.explanation: 'Am' becomes 'was', and 'I' becomes 'he'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: The children said, "We don't want to leave yet."
options: The children said that we didn't want to leave yet.
The children said that they didn't want to leave yet.
The children said that they don't want to leave yet.
quests.correctAnswer: The children said that they didn't want to leave yet.
quests.sentence: The children said, "We don't want to leave yet."
quests.hint: Recall how 'we' changes when someone else reports a group's words, and how negatives shift tense.
quests.explanation: 'We' becomes 'they', and 'don't want' becomes 'didn't want'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Zara said, "My phone is not working properly."
options: Zara said that her phone was not working properly.
Zara said that her phone is not working properly.
Zara said that my phone was not working properly.
quests.correctAnswer: Zara said that her phone was not working properly.
quests.sentence: Zara said, "My phone is not working properly."
quests.hint: This question checks three things at once: the possessive, the verb 'to be', and the continuous form.
quests.explanation: 'My' becomes 'her', and 'is not working' becomes 'was not working'.
